card.name: Partway through brand names and units
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of split-up brand names (DATSCAN, KEBILIDI, CIBINQO), drug names, and unit or number strings such as µg, CYP3A4 and m2. It is a mid-string spot where the next piece is hard to guess.

modes.label: Inside brand or drug names
modes.description: A split piece in the middle of a capitalized brand name or a long drug name.

modes.label: Inside units and numbers
modes.description: A piece of a unit, enzyme code, or number in dosing or table text.
